title: Still Walking 2008 question regarding the grandpa

commenti.body: I'm a little fuzzy on this one since it's been a while, but yeah I recall it being implied that he unfaithful a long time ago, and the wife more or less wanted him to know that she knew, but that she ultimately didn't really care that much anymore

Yes, that was also my interpretation from when I watched it some time ago. She knew about the affair but now it's just water under the bridge. I also read it as a way of showing the strong patriarchal structure in the society and lives of the family, a theme that is shown through other scenes and characters.
